plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Welding map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The inventoried program 'Welding' is listed in the mapper under the name 'Welding'; the program details state the student will be awarded a Welding Associate of Science degree. This plan transcribes the program's only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Welding / Associate of Science / 67-71.5 units / 4 terms / to Degree', in full. In 2025-2026 the same pathway was listed at 67-71.5 units in 6 terms (the two extra terms carried only milestone rows) with identical course content in the same order, except that WELD B74A's title is printed in 2025-2026 as 'Introduction to GMAW (Gas Metal Arc Welding) and FCAW (Flux Core Arc Welding)'; in 2026-2027 it is printed, in both views, as 'Introduction GMAW Gas Metal Arc Welding and FCAW Flux Core Arc Weld' and is transcribed here exactly as printed for 2026-2027. The mapper also lists a separate Welding Certificate of Achievement program, a different credential, which was not transcribed. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 67-71.5 units, and term totals as 19 / 15-17.5 / 16 / 17-19. Ranged rows: Term 2 'Major List A' (2-3) and '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5); Term 4 'Major List A' (2-3, printed twice as two separate slots). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 67 units. The 'Major List A' slot is printed once in Term 2 and twice in Term 4 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. Rows printed with a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View (Term 3: WELD B55A, WELD B55B, WELD B55C; Term 4: WELD B71) carry the flag disclosure on the row; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. No Corequisites or Dual Enrollment flags appear. General-education and major-list slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
